New rule 2026 (corpus-maturation pass): PWGmc apocope of word-final short high vowels after heavy syllables in unstressed words (R/T 2014: 57-58). Prosodically conditioned, exceptionless; licenses PWGmc *iuwi ~ *iuw sentence-sandhi doublet (R/T 2014: 41-42); OE eow continues the unstressed variant (no i-umlaut). Fed by SC020; bleeds SC055. Corpus witness: you (*izwiz > eow). Proxy environment over the SC008 geminate *ww domain (transcription carries no word-stress mark); cf. SC096 proxy convention.

New late-pre-OE/WS rule from the SC021 adjudication: shortened unstressed *o (< original PWGmc *ō) > u in medial syllables. Direct evidence is restricted to West Saxon ō-verb pasts (Stausland Johnsen 2015: 28-31, 36); *wúndōdē > wundude is the selected witness. It is not a continuation of retired SC021's disputed short-*o PNWGmc claim.

Paired final-syllable outcome of shortened unstressed *o (< original *ō): *o > a. The SC099/SC100 contrast follows Stausland Johnsen 2015: 28-31; see the SC021 adjudication for its limited evidential domain and chronology.
